name: Akhil Srinivas Parimala
bio: I'm a software engineer who enjoys building back-end systems and the web applications on top of them, mostly with Python, Flask, Vue and Nuxt.

I studied Computer Science and Engineering at VIT Vellore alongside a BS in Data Science and Applications at IIT Madras. I've interned with Oracle Communications at Oracle India and built the back end of an e-commerce platform at Powstik.
Outside of code, I've spent years leading student communities: chairing Ayuda NGO at VIT and co-founding Cosmos, the technical society of IIT Madras BS.
